SATIN AUTO WRAP INC.
VEHICLE WRAP DESIGN AGREEMENT
This Design Agreement is entered into between Satin Auto Wrap Inc. ("Designer" or "Service Provider") and the Customer.

1. DESIGN SERVICES
Satin Auto Wrap will create custom vehicle wrap design concepts, layouts, mockups, render-ready artwork, and revisions for the Customer's project.

2. DESIGN FEE
Standard Design Fee: $250 + applicable taxes
• The design fee covers consultation, concept development, mockups, revisions, renderings, and artwork preparation.
• Design fees are non-refundable once work has commenced.
• If Satin Auto Wrap is offering a Free Design Promotion, the $250 design fee is considered included in the overall project price and will not be charged separately.
• If the Customer proceeds with production and installation through Satin Auto Wrap, any paid design fee may be credited toward the final project cost where applicable.

3. DESIGN PROCESS
• Satin Auto Wrap will provide up to three (3) initial design concepts.
• The Customer must select one (1) concept for further development.
• Up to ten (10) revisions are included on the selected concept.
• Additional revisions are billed at $25 per revision.
• Requests for an entirely new concept after delivery of the original concepts will require a new design fee.
• Design work begins only after the required deposit and all necessary project information have been received.
• Design timelines vary based on workload, project complexity, revisions, and customer response times.
• Initial concepts may take one (1) week or longer depending on production schedules.
• All design communication, approvals, and revisions are conducted remotely via email, phone, text, or other digital communication methods.
• Estimated timelines are not guaranteed.

4. MOCKUPS & RENDERINGS
• Complimentary 3D renderings are typically provided for Full Wrap and Half Wrap projects when available.
• Decal packages, partial wraps, and smaller projects may require an additional rendering fee.
• If an exact vehicle template is unavailable, Satin Auto Wrap may provide an alternative mockup or visual representation.
• Renderings are for design approval purposes only and may not represent exact production dimensions, colours, or installation details.

5. CUSTOMER RESPONSIBILITIES
• The Customer is responsible for providing accurate logos, branding materials, images, contact information, and project details.
• The Customer is responsible for reviewing all proofs and approvals carefully.
• Satin Auto Wrap is not responsible for poor print quality resulting from low-resolution or unsuitable files supplied by the Customer.

6. AI-GENERATED CONCEPTS
• AI-generated images may be used for inspiration and concept development only.
• Final production artwork may require redesign, vectorization, or modification.
• Satin Auto Wrap does not guarantee exact reproduction of AI-generated concepts.

7. COLOUR APPROVAL
• Printed colours may vary from digital proofs, monitors, mobile devices, and AI-generated images.
• Test prints are available upon request.
• If a test print is declined, Satin Auto Wrap is not responsible for colour variations between digital previews and final printed materials.

8. DESIGN OWNERSHIP
• All concepts, artwork, mockups, renderings, source files, and production files remain the property of Satin Auto Wrap unless otherwise agreed in writing.
• The design fee covers design services only and does not transfer ownership rights.
• Customers wishing to obtain editable production files may purchase a Design Buyout.
Minimum Design Buyout Fee: $750 + applicable taxes
• Until a buyout is completed, the Customer may not reproduce, print, distribute, modify, or provide the design to third parties for production.

9. FINAL APPROVAL
• Once final approval is provided, all spelling, contact information, layouts, and design elements become the Customer's responsibility.
• Changes requested after final approval may result in additional charges and production delays.
• Final approval authorizes Satin Auto Wrap to proceed with production.

10. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
Satin Auto Wrap's liability shall be limited to the amount paid for design services and shall not be responsible for indirect, consequential, or business-related losses.

11. ACCEPTANCE OF TERMS
By signing electronically, the Customer confirms that they have read, understood, and agree to all terms contained in this Agreement.

INSTALLATION TERMS
Installation is $3 per square foot, subject to a site assessment and confirmation of scope.
Provide accurate dimensions in inches and describe the installation height, access, surface condition and any existing graphics.
The work area must be clear, safe and accessible. Glass or walls must be suitable, dry and free from damage. Fresh paint must fully cure according to its manufacturer's instructions.
Existing vinyl and adhesive removal or additional cleaning is charged at $75 per hour. This charge is additional to installation and will be confirmed before work begins.
High or difficult access, lifts, scaffolding, repairs and unusual preparation are quoted separately before approval.

settings.wallGuide:
Measure the widest and tallest points of your wall in inches. Add the extra trimming allowance recommended for your project. Prepare a clean, dry, smooth wall and let fresh paint cure fully. Lay out panels in order; align the first panel carefully and smooth from the centre outward. Trim edges only after checking the alignment. Follow the supplied material-specific instructions.
Flat Matte gives a smooth, low-reflection finish. Texture adds a tactile surface and visual depth. Removable and permanent adhesives have the same price; choose for your wall and intended duration. Test adhesion first—removable does not guarantee damage-free removal on every painted surface.
settings.detailingIntro: A cleaner cabin. A deeper shine. A finish worth protecting. Choose a starting plan and we will tailor it to your vehicle.
settings.detailingAftercare: Before your visit, remove personal belongings and tell us about stains, pet hair, paint damage or previous coatings. We inspect the vehicle and confirm your plan before starting. After detailing, use gentle pH-balanced wash products and clean microfibre towels. Follow the curing and first-wash guidance supplied for your coating.
